content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IISER Thiruvananthapuram Athletic coach & Mass PT Trainer Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 28-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Athletic coach & Mass PT Trainer position at IISER Thiruvananthapuram?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 28 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Athletic coach & Mass PT Trainer post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Diploma in coaching athletics or a Bachelor of Physical Education with Athletics specialization.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Athletic coach & Mass PT Trainer role?
faq.answer: The selection process details are not explicitly mentioned here and should be referred to in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Athletic coach & Mass PT Trainer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 1100/- per session.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Thiruvananthapuram (IISER Thiruvananthapuram).

faq.question: Q10. Where is IISER Thiruvananthapuram located?
faq.answer: IISER Thiruvananthapuram is located in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.
